statements.t: “We have expanded our clinical site network from three to nine active sites and expect enrollment in ACESOT-1051 to reach six to ten patients per month during the fourth quarter of 2026, positioning us to accelerate clinical development.

We look forward to presenting updated Phase 1 clinical results at the upcoming EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics and remain on track to select the dose for Part 2 of the study, focused on dose optimization, in the first half of 2027.

With $37.8 million in cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2026, and an expected cash runway into the first quarter of 2028, we believe we are well positioned to execute our clinical development strategy, achieve meaningful milestones, and create long-term value for patients and shareholders.”

The Company may use, and intends to use, its investor relations website at https://ir.aprea.com/ as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.
